title: ebr-route/1: one bus line going one way

id.description: OSM relation id, or 3e12 + a stable hash for a line made from a timetable / by hand

t.description: tags of the line, the ones the mod reads: ref, name, from, to, network, operator, colour, public_transport:version, ...

ways.description: the road of the line: ways in the order the map lists them; empty = the data service asks a routing server for it

t.description: tags of the way that give a speed limit

stops.description: stops in the order the source lists them (the mod puts them in order along the road)

s.description: id of a stop in the tiles

r.description: role in the relation: platform, stop, ...

o.description: seconds from the start of the trip (lines with a timetable)

la.description: latitude of the stop (a copy of the tile's, written by the builder)

times.description: departures from the first stop on a typical weekday / Saturday / Sunday, minutes of the day (may pass 1440)

src.description: where the line comes from; the licence of each source is in sources/
